events.input: $ cd /tmp/t217-twl && git status --short | grep '^D' | cut -c1-140; git commit -q -m "Mirror: main 97096ab (T-217 reminders by Tantra campaign import, probe sign-in fix)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait until the public mirror serves the new build, then show the time and the end of the log
events.input: $ n=0; until curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/?v=8215fd7" | grep -q FRbDE8zMhgTyAFtRZRpC5; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -ge 24 ] && break; sleep 10; done; echo "tries $n"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/?v=8215fd7b"; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/?v=8215fd7c" | grep -c FRbDE8zMhgTyAFtRZRpC5; date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"; wc -l < /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md; tail -1 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-120

| Push main | Done | `origin/main` is at 97096ab, confirmed by ls-remote. |

| (1) No `TANTRA_NOTE`, `TANTRA_WAIT` or "per-contact send" in `cloud/src` and `app/src` | Done | `git grep` on main returns nothing. `tsc` exits 0 in `cloud`. |
| (2) Cards, playbook and guides say nothing about Tantra sending being pending | Done, nothing to fix | The scan found no leftover wording. `tantra-reminder-endpoint.md` is already marked retired. |
| (3) Probes pass on the simulator, registrant enrolled by `POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts` | Done, with one probe not run | `probe-tantra-reminders`: 92 pass, 0 fail. `probe-email-stripe`: 58 pass, 0 fail, after I fixed its admin sign-in (903406a, 97096ab). `probe-funnel-whatsapp` was not run. |
| (4) Live centre test run shows reminder email as pass, and a held email as a setup step | Partly done | Both readings were proven on a private simulator stack running the code that is now deployed. It was not run on the live centre, because production cannot reach a local simulator and has no deployed attendee funnel. |
| Ripple R-fc69507f (reminders now use campaign import) | Done, no code change needed | The review criteria were re-checked against the campaign-import model. The task's spec text is unchanged because `pass.py` cannot edit it; the note says so. |
| Twilio WhatsApp removal | Out of scope | Stays with T-264, as the Orchestrator said. |
| Set T-217 status, add evidence, ack notes | Done | Status is review with 3 evidence links. F-b7d07f86 and R-fc69507f are acked. Reviewers remain Adi and Bharath. |
| Tidy up | Done | Temporary worktree, mirror clone and simulator files removed. |
